description: Language identification, highlighting, hover docs, linter, outline, live JSON inspect, and JSON↔XAIOP encode for XAIOP (.xaiop)
cmd.wrapRoot: XAIOP: Wrap Fragment as JSON Document
config.lint.enabled: Lint .xaiop files (syntax + JSON materialization) while editing.
config.lint.compat: Use SDK compatibility repairs (not the strict wire). Off by default.
config.lint.fragmentSeverity: Severity when the stream is a root fragment (valid wire, not a standalone JSON document).
config.lint.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds before re-linting after edits.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show parse / JSON status in the status bar (click to inspect).
config.preview.follow: When the live JSON inspector is open, follow the active .xaiop editor.
config.encode.dotPolicy: How often encode emits `.` between top-level keys (`none` = one relative tree).
config.encode.style: Encode style when `dotPolicy` is `none`: `relative` (single `>` root) or `reset`.
config.inlay.types: Show Content type inlays (int / float / bool / null / forced-string; skip plain strings).
config.inspect.autoOpen: Open the live JSON inspector beside a .xaiop editor (close it once to keep it closed for this session).
config.inspect.followCursor: Scroll and highlight the JSON node under the cursor while inspecting.
config.inspect.hover: Show the materialized JSON at the cursor in hover.
